svg.title: Machine Identities: Automation Acts as Itself
svg.desc: Each automation need maps to its identity: GitHub API work across repositories to a GitHub App with one-hour tokens, a server pulling one repository to a read-only deploy key, cloud deploys to OIDC, and personal scripts to a short-lived fine-grained token.
svg.text: Machine Identities: Automation Acts as Itself
Pick the narrowest, shortest-lived credential that does the job.
Deploy to AWS, Azure or GCP
Short expiry; tied to a person
